The new Atlantic system was being constructed as an interpolity regime that would regulate, not eliminate, maritime violence and preserve imperial rights to use force and coercion to calibrate order.
zh: 向新国家施压、要求遏制私掠，是这一协调计划的一部分。正如西班牙外交官敦促美国政府禁止从美国港口出发的私掠，英国政府也试图向南美洲官员施压，要求他们节制对私掠的支持。与驻美国的西班牙外交官不同，英国人无法通过领事施加影响，因此，向新政府传递压力的工具，只能是英国海军。
海军部报告称，海军渠道取得了一些成效。在布宜诺斯艾利斯，政府采取措施，要求私掠者起航前登记缴纳更高额的保证金；新成立的智利政府也同意介入，保护那些在仍由西班牙控制的秘鲁港口从事贸易的英国船只。然而，英国政府没有要求更强硬的措施，而是选择在正式的不干涉政策内，嵌入有限干预的制度。
若把所有获新政府许可的劫掠者都称为海盗，就会质疑新实体的国家地位，包括它们发动战争的权利。这会削弱英国政府正在低调强化的那些主权主张。
新的大西洋体系，正在被建构为一种政治体间制度：它规制海上暴力，而非消灭海上暴力，并保留帝国使用武力与强制来调节秩序的权利。

en: Beyond Piracy
zh: 海盗行为之外

en: The

raids and the disputes they produced about booty and piracy spanned the crucial years of Atlantic political transformation. Daniels followed other U.S. mariners who began to raid for South American governments of uncertain status in 1816. Just seven years later, as the Supreme Court was ruling in the last of the cases involving the

captures, imperial policies had shifted the political horizon. Empires still dominated, and micro-polities persisted. But some entities, like Artigas’s Banda Oriental, had succumbed to imperial invasion, and others had joined emergent nations or negotiated tenuous arrangements to retain a measure of autonomy within imperial spheres of influence. Even as the precise political contours of the region remained unstable, the new order was reaffirming a narrowing list of political possibilities. Daniels conformed to the new order by taking a commission in the Colombian navy, a position that secured his profits and allowed him a comfortable retirement in Baltimore.
zh: 的劫掠，以及由此产生的战利品与海盗争议，横跨大西洋政治转变的关键年份。1816年，其他美国海员开始替地位未定的南美洲政府实施劫掠，丹尼尔斯追随其后。仅仅七年后，当最高法院对涉及“不可抗拒号”捕获物的最后一宗案件作出判决时，帝国政策已经改变了政治的可能范围。帝国仍占据支配地位，微小政治体也继续存在。但一些实体，如阿蒂加斯的东岸地区，已屈服于帝国入侵；另一些加入了新兴国家，或通过谈判达成脆弱安排，在帝国势力范围内保留一定自治。尽管该地区确切的政治轮廓仍不稳定，新秩序却不断确认一个日益收窄的政治可能性清单。丹尼尔斯通过接受哥伦比亚海军任命，适应了新秩序；这一职位保住了他的利润，也使他能够在巴尔的摩安享退休生活。

en: Placing maritime violence and its regulation at the center of regional change alters narratives about international legal order in this period. Historians have shown that a discourse about degrees of civilization became a central focus of efforts to define the membership of new American states in the international legal community.

This account is correct as far as it goes. In conflicts over the legitimacy of privateering and the political order behind it, we glimpse a much more varied set of connections between state formation and the new regional order. Privateers, their sponsors, and their challengers were forced to address fundamental questions about the shape of the international order as they engaged in conflicts over the lawfulness of captures at sea.
zh: 把海上暴力及其规制置于地区变化的中心，会改变有关这一时期国际法律秩序的叙述。历史学家已经表明，关于文明程度的话语，成为界定美洲新国家在国际法律共同体中成员资格的核心焦点。
这一解释在其所及范围内是正确的。但在围绕私掠及其背后政治秩序之合法性的冲突中，我们看到了国家形成与新区域秩序之间丰富得多的联系。私掠者、他们的支持者及挑战者，在围绕海上捕获是否合法展开冲突时，被迫回应国际秩序形态的根本问题。

en: It was mandatory for polities to position themselves in relation to the shifting order. The United States was a case in point. Emerging tentatively as a regional power, the country remained weak and buffeted by more powerful empires. It has become commonplace to describe the Monroe Doctrine as a framework for U.S. imperialism, but the muscular version of the doctrine was articulated decades later to justify U.S. territorial expansion and the extension of slavery.
In the early decades of the nineteenth century, U.S. leaders endorsed an Atlantic system of states in part as a bulwark

the power of empires. To recover this vision is not to deny U.S. ambitions of regional hegemony. It allows us to recognize the dominance of European empires, to identify forces other than revolutionary movements shaping the international Atlantic, and to widen the list of participants engaged in constitutional projects at the intersection of sovereignty and international law.
zh: 各政治体必须在变化中的秩序面前为自己定位，美国就是一例。它正试探性地作为地区强国崛起，却仍然弱小，受到更强大帝国的冲击。把门罗主义描述为美国帝国主义的框架，已成为常见做法；但这一学说的强硬版本，是数十年后才被明确提出的，用以为美国领土扩张及奴隶制扩展辩护。
在十九世纪最初几十年，美国领导人支持大西洋国家体系，部分是为了把它作为
帝国权力的堡垒。恢复这一愿景，并不是否认美国谋求地区霸权的野心；它使我们能够认识欧洲帝国的支配地位，辨识除革命运动之外塑造国际性大西洋的力量，并扩展参与者名单：这些参与者在主权与国际法的交汇处，从事着宪政构建。

en: Conflicts over maritime violence highlight the ideological eclecticism and political improvisation of the age. As with Artigas’s constitutionalism, the rhetoric of liberty was consistent with visions of layered sovereignty and confederation, and revolutionary talk among men like Daniels meshed with their opportunism. We have seen, too, that privateering produced an ocean of unintended consequences. Raiders bolstered bids for recognition by some new states while exposing others to destabilizing external pressures. Privateering practices were equally available to anti-imperial agents, slave traders, and counterrevolutionaries. Indeed, once privateering commissions were in circulation, their itineraries were unpredictable. Commissions issued by Artigas showed up in Atlantic prize courts in the possession of active slave traders even after the Banda Oriental had fallen to Luso-Brazilian forces and Artigas was in exile.
zh: 围绕海上暴力的冲突，凸显了这一时代意识形态上的兼收并蓄与政治上的即兴应变。正如阿蒂加斯的宪政主义，自由修辞可以与分层主权及邦联的愿景相容；丹尼尔斯等人的革命言论，也与其机会主义相契合。我们还看到，私掠造成了海量的意外后果。劫掠者强化了某些新国家寻求承认的主张，却也使另一些国家暴露于破坏稳定的外部压力之下。反帝国行动者、奴隶贩子和反革命者，都同样可以运用私掠实践。事实上，私掠委任状一旦进入流通，其流转路径便不可预测。即使东岸地区已经落入葡萄牙—巴西军队之手，阿蒂加斯也已流亡，他颁发的委任状仍出现在大西洋捕获法庭上，由仍在经营的奴隶贩子持有。

en: More broadly, the

story reminds us of the dangers of taking too literally the rhetoric about pirates as enemies of all. In the early nineteenth century, the discourse gained political force while losing legal precision. As Arlyck observes, nothing about the “conceptual elegance” of piracy law prevented it from being “knotty in application.”

But even the conceptual clarity of the term “piracy” was dimmed by the indeterminacies of the Atlantic system. Uncertainties about the character of states and the unequal distribution of the right to make war made the law of piracy an interpretive field, not a firm foundation for marking exclusion from the international order.
zh: 更广泛地说，
的故事提醒我们，过于照字面理解“海盗是所有人的敌人”的修辞，存在危险。在十九世纪早期，这套话语获得政治力量，却失去法律精确性。正如阿利克所言，海盗法的“概念优雅”，丝毫没有阻止它在“适用中盘根错节”。
但即便“海盗”一词的概念清晰性，也被大西洋体系的不确定性削弱。国家性质的不确定，以及战争权利的不平等分配，使海盗法成为一个诠释场域，而非标明谁被排除于国际秩序之外的坚实基础。

en: These findings matter as pirates are frequently—and often casually—cited as models for other supposedly universal enemies, most recently terrorists (including imagined “narco-terrorists” and “domestic terrorists”).

The language of universal enmity implies that any state (and perhaps any private organization) can claim jurisdiction to attack and kill people labeled as enemies of all. Yet, as with piracy and privateering, the conclusion that a group sits outside the international legal order is often based on little more than rhetorical flourish. Some groups labeled as outcasts operate with funding from states and some are endorsed or run by quasi-sovereign entities, while very few groups fit the category of truly independent or roguish actors. As with campaigns against sea raiding, the natural law foundations of the “war on terror” matter much less than the structure and synchrony of state policies.
In our search for massive disruptions to the international order, we would do well to shift our attention from criminal rogues to criminal polities.
zh: 这些发现之所以重要，是因为海盗经常——而且往往随意地——被当作其他所谓普遍敌人的模型，最近的例子是恐怖分子，包括想象中的“毒品恐怖分子”和“国内恐怖分子”。

普遍敌对的语言暗示，任何国家——甚至也许任何私人组织——都可以主张管辖权，攻击并杀死被贴上“所有人的敌人”标签的人。然而，正如海盗与私掠的情况，认定某个群体处于国际法律秩序之外，往往几乎仅仅依据夸张的修辞。一些被称为秩序外弃民的群体，接受国家资助运作；另一些则获准主权实体认可，或由它们经营；真正符合完全独立或不受约束行动者这一类别的群体，少之又少。正如打击海上劫掠的行动，“反恐战争”的自然法基础，远不如国家政策的结构与同步性重要。
在寻找对国际秩序造成重大破坏的力量时，我们应把注意力从犯罪的无赖，转向犯罪的政治体。

en: With these themes and the story of the

in mind, we can return to the debates about piracy with which we began. Romantic representations of pirates deserve our skepticism not only because they fly in the face of copious evidence about sea raiders’ connections and aspirations. They also encourage a dangerously simplistic, inaccurate view of maritime violence and international ordering. Sea raiders like Daniels were, along with the sea of states in which they navigated, forced to become hyper-political actors. They deployed a mix of well-known strategies, from altering ships’ documents to changing citizenship to forum shopping, while inventing new ways to maneuver through political systems of many moving parts. Sea raiding both pinned states firmly in the crosswinds of imperial power and helped to summon into existence a new interpolity order.
zh: 带着这些主题与

的故事，我们可以回到文章开头的海盗辩论。对海盗的浪漫化描绘，值得我们怀疑，不仅因为它们违背了有关海上劫掠者的社会联系与志向的大量证据，还因为它们鼓励一种危险地简单化且不准确的海上暴力与国际秩序形成观。丹尼尔斯这样的海上劫掠者，与他们航行其间的国家之海一道，被迫成为高度政治化的行动者。他们综合运用各种熟知的策略，从改动船舶文件、变更国籍，到选择有利法庭，同时发明新的办法，在由众多不断变动的部分组成的政治体系中周旋。海上劫掠既把国家牢牢置于帝国权力交错的风向之中，也促成了一种新的政治体间秩序的诞生。

en: Daniels was not especially successful as a wartime privateer. On his first outings, he captained two vessels that were seized by British ships and captured only a handful of small vessels. A fourth cruise yielded valuable prizes, but Daniels ran aground in the waters off Cape May, once unintentionally and once intentionally, to avoid capture by British blockading vessels. Hopkins, “For Flag and Profit,” 392–401, 393–94. In contrast, another Baltimore captain who later turned South American privateer, Joseph Almeida, captured 30 vessels during the war and cleared $46,000 in profits. Head, “Independence on the Quarterdeck,” 7.
zh: 丹尼尔斯作为战时私掠者，并不特别成功。最初几次出航，他指挥的两艘船被英国船只捕获，自己仅捕获少量小船。第四次巡航取得了贵重捕获物，但丹尼尔斯在五月岬外海搁浅两次：一次出于意外，一次则是为了避免被英国封锁舰艇捕获而故意为之。 Hopkins, “For Flag and Profit〔题名译释：为了旗帜与利润〕,” 392–401, 393–94. 相比之下，另一位后来成为南美洲私掠者的巴尔的摩船长约瑟夫·阿尔梅达，在战争期间捕获30艘船，获得46,000美元净利。 Head, “Independence on the Quarterdeck〔题名译释：后甲板上的独立〕,” 7.

en: Daniels had also traded to Haiti for this firm before the War of 1812. Hopkins, “For Flag and Profit,” 394. Daniels’s wife was born as Eugenia Caze in St. Domingue in 1795. She would have arrived in Baltimore sometime after the first surge of refugees from St. Domingue in 1793, when 1,500 refugees, including about 500 Blacks (a mix of free and enslaved people), traveled to the city on fifty-three ships from Cap François ( Hartridge, Walter Charlton, “The Refugees from the Island of St. Domingo in Maryland,” The Maryland Historical Magazine 38, 2 (1943): 103–122 ). en: Part of the difficulty stemmed from recent attempts to strengthen laws against piracy, precisely in response to the creative strategies of North American mariners engaged in raiding. Besides the authorization in the Constitution of Congress to make laws to regulate piracy, the baseline for policy was congressional legislation in 1790, the Act for the Punishment of Certain Crimes Against the United States (Act of Apr. 30, 1790, ch. 9, 8, 1 stat. 112 [1790]). The Act established that murder, robbery, and other crimes on the high seas would be punishable by death if the same crimes committed on land were defined as capital crimes under the laws of the United States. In 1812, a Massachusetts case raised the question of whether piracy had to include violence (United States v. Tully, 28 F. Cas. 226 [C.C. Mass 1812]; Alfred P., Rubin,

, International Law Studies 63 [Newport: Naval War College Press, 1988], 128–137). In 1818, the U.S. Supreme Court interpreted the 1790 act to mean that a robbery committed on the high seas “belonging exclusively to subjects of a foreign state” could not be considered piracy and punishable by death if the same crime could not carry a death sentence in U.S. courts (quoted in Samuels, “The Full Story of United States v. Smith,” 334).
